blocks.text: Celebrate 135 years of trusted lighting and get a chance to win exciting prizes with Philips. Philips marks its 135th anniversary with a nationwide promotion that started from September 1 until December 27, 2026, giving Filipino consumers more reasons to choose trusted lighting solutions for their homes and businesses. Customers can join by purchasing at least ₱500 worth of participating Philips Lighting products in a single receipt from participating stores nationwide. Every qualifying ₱500 purchase earns one raffle entry, subject to the official promo mechanics.
